title: Sphere recovered from a crashed craft
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: started talking about that it was recovered in a from a a craft that had crashed they said that they did say that

plain: A man named Randy Anderson, speaking to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he saw alien technology at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a US Navy research base in Indiana, around 2014. According to Anderson, the people there talked about a sphere and said it had been recovered from a craft that crashed. If true, it would mean the military holds pieces of a non-human vehicle.
